Solid Y is added to an excess of hot water.
A blue solution forms and a brown solid remains.
The brown solid is filtered off and dried.
The brown solid conducts electricity.
What is Y?
A
a compound that contains a metal
B
a mixture that contains a metal
C
a pure substance that is a metal
D
a pure substance that is a non-metal

options.label: A
options.text: a compound that contains a metal

options.text: a mixture that contains a metal
